newsitem.title: GERMANY: Thyssen says capacity utilisation rises.
newsitem.headline: Thyssen says capacity utilisation rises.

text.p: Thyssen Stahl AG, Germany's largest steel maker, said its capacity utilisation improved in the last months of fiscal 1995/96.
Flat-rolled steel production returned to normal levels after months of curtailed output and shortened working hours, the company said in a magazine for employees.
Incoming orders stabilised at a higher level, but blast-furnace modernisation and remodeling at the Bruckhausen continuous casting plant had negative effects on output.
Thyssen Stahl said earlier it produced about 13 percent less raw steel in the year to September 30 than in the year before.
Sales declined 11 percent to 10.6 billion marks. The company said the group is profitable, but gave no figures.
